entries.zh: 物种类别对你的帝国没有太大影响，但与其他类别相比，同是人形类的物种，双方认同感会更强。
entries.en: Species Class has no effect on your Empire, but Humanoid-class Species may consider other Humanoids to be less alien than other Species Classes.
